description: DAD (Duplicate Address Detection) hash algorithm clarification vectors. CRC32-IEEE (ISO HDLC, reflected poly 0xedb88320) seeded with the low 32 bits of ASCII "LICHEN" (0x4348454e) is the authoritative short-address derivation per spec 02-physical-link.md section 4.5 (project-LICHEN-bo37). FNV-1a32 vectors are retained for oracle-parity comparison only.
oracle_provenance: Independent implementation of both hash algorithms. CRC32-IEEE uses polynomial 0x04C11DB7 with initial value truncated from 0x4c494348454e to 0x4348454e (32-bit). FNV-1a32 uses basis 0x811c9dc5 and prime 0x01000193.

resolution.note: CRC32-IEEE (ISO HDLC) seeded with the low 32 bits of ASCII "LICHEN" (0x4348454e) is the authoritative short-address derivation, resolving the duplicated spec 02-physical-link.md section 4.5 pseudocode in favor of the crc32_ieee form (project-LICHEN-bo37; matching Python lichen.link.short_addr and Rust lichen-core short_addr). FNV-1a32 vectors are retained for oracle-parity comparison only (basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193).
